scope: Song-semantic refinement of the verified v0.12.2 exhibition. Four independent material languages, four ways of keeping a memory: approach, undo, longing and aftersound. No audio or long lyric quotations.
presentation: The existing sculptural cores remain. Yesterday, Today keeps its exterior title, unlettered botanical lens and v0.12.1 pearl rim; new almost-meeting sleeves carry autumn impressions. Deleted develops one original room exposure from red-blue to monochrome. Poem connects its river, moonlit margin and unwritten folio. Rain holds wet photographs and a split instant behind the original silver veil. No red hose.
images: Four same-scene editions: 1600px covers, posters, three independent material cameras, profile, verso and reloaded GLB per work. Yesterday, Today additionally has newly photographed 2048px mobile plates. Exact provenance and output hashes are recorded in each build.json.
modelLimitations: GLB omits web lighting, bloom, rain animation and interaction. Garden is a static snapshot; its mineral ground uses authored vertex colours rather than the browser-only grain shader.
navigation: Unchanged four-world order, native picker and contextual gallery return
mobilePresentation: The v0.12.2 viewing system is preserved: touch devices up to 900 CSS pixels enter with high-resolution still plates and opt into the full live scenes. New same-scene photographs replace the previous art edition. Native 1200/2048px entry, 2048px Yesterday, Today inspection, pinch/pan/double-tap, native scrolling and safe-area-aware controls are retained.
